author: lishunyang12
body: This is common request-mode lifecycle cleanup, not DLO-only. In e55738af I named the join timeout (`_ASYNC_OUTPUT_THREAD_JOIN_TIMEOUT_S`) and added a real spawn-based per-worker result-queue regression. DLO/DP makes the lifecycle issue easier to trigger, but the shutdown path remains shared by all request-mode workers.

author: lishunyang12
body: Addressed in e55738af. Both deserializers now use `_array_from_shm`, which attaches, copies, closes, and unlinks the segment in one place; `_tensor_from_shm` additionally restores the torch dtype. The new spawn-based test round-trips nested NumPy outputs through two worker-owned queues and verifies every SHM name is gone afterward.

author: lishunyang12
body: Addressed in e55738af by reusing the complete scheduler sampling-compatibility key before DP dispatch. It covers output shape, CFG mode/value, denoise steps/sigmas, output count, and LoRA, while `extra_args` is still checked separately. Different prompt token lengths remain valid: ranks execute independent requests and only need an identical collective schedule, not identical compute time. A bounded DP-wave timeout now fails closed if an unforeseen asymmetric path still occurs. Tests cover mismatched steps, CFG, and width being rejected before dispatch, plus valid shared defaults (`num_inference_steps=None`).

author: lishunyang12
body: Good point. For a DLO+DP AllGather wave, the preflight now reuses `RequestBatchSamplingParamsKey`, so shape (height/width/frames), CFG/guidance values, denoise schedule, output count, LoRA, and `extra_args` must match exactly; prompt text/token length and seed/generator may differ. H3 is CFG-distilled and always runs one transformer forward per step, so CFG does not alter its collective count, while different token lengths are allowed and only add a straggler/perf cost because they do not change the DLO AllGather sequence.
